My grandfather planted all these apple trees.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who planted' identifies the agent with a relative clause.

gaps.lead: He'd rather not discuss the matter.
gaps.explanation: would prefer + not + to-infinitive: prefer not to discuss.

gaps.lead: The villagers used to fetch water from the well.
gaps.sentence: The villagers ___ fetch water from the well.
gaps.explanation: would + infinitive also expresses a repeated past action (with action verbs).

gaps.lead: I got used to night shifts after a month.
gaps.sentence: After a month, I ___ night shifts.
gaps.explanation: After a period: be used to (state) or had got used to (achievement).
